Not to consume a batch of bottled preserved bean curd containing excessive Bacillus cereus

Issue Date13.10.2025
Source of InformationCentre for Food Safety
Food ProductBottled preserved bean curd
Product Name and Description

Product name: Salted bean curd cubes in brine with chili (with sesame oil)

Brand: Giant Tree

Place of origin: China

Net weight: 130 grams

Best-before date: August 19, 2027

Distributor: Foundation Agents Ltd.

Reason For Issuing Alert
  • The test result showed that the sample contained Bacillus cereus at a level of 180,000 per gram.
  • Consuming food contaminated with excessive Bacillus cereus may cause gastrointestinal upset.
